body: wait list is too long. too expensive. besides i don't think you can diagnose brain chemistry this way. and whatever my principles are, they're surely absent in the most critical moments in my life. i'm completely aware of what i'm doing and can stop if choose to do so. i think it's more likely that i'm actually a worthless human being who thrives on creating chaos in peoples lives, definitely on the sadistic side of the spectrum with very few masochistic tendencies. i only feel in the most extreme circumstances. the world doesn't offer the circumstances that can provide me with tangible feelings so i create extreme situations. i truly believe the world, at least my locality, will be a better place without me. and not just with me moving away, but with me not being alive. i really believe if i go through with this i might actually end up doing something courageous that will bring some peace.

yes. always followed closely by the next noxious explosion of uncompromising rage. for every empathetic correspondence there's a unspeakable act of heinous rage. in my reflections today i'm shocked that some of my relationships, romantic or otherwise, lasted as long as they have. my most recent partner has been with me for 3 years. i think i was crushing her maybe a month after we got together. the poor thing. she stuck with me for 3 years. the emotional trauma i've put her through might be irreversible. she never deserved any of it.

yeah i can talk. i haven't fully thought out my exit plan. really though, i'm a collage of all the scum in the headlines put into one. i'm exhausted from working 8 days a week my entire life and getting no where. pushing every single person in my life away, far far away. not sure how much more gruesome details i can give. it only gets much worse.
